title: Heart Attack
excerpt: My first great fortune was meeting my wife to whom I was married for 37 years. Sadly she passed away from cancer.
content:
My first great fortune was meeting my wife to whom I was married for 37 years. Sadly she passed away from cancer. Lonely, once again I married and this time cancer took my second wife a few years later. Once again alone I met my next wife on a plane flying over Scandinavia at 50,000 feet. My third wife died within 13 months of the day of our wedding.

In 1977 I heard about Hippocrates and went to Boston. I was impressed with the program and gave up meat and dairy. With my history of health problems, encephalitis, uremic poisoning and several heart attacks, the Hippocrates diet and exercise program has worked well for me! I still work outside in my yard here in Richardson, Texas and live a good healthy life.

Vol 21 Issue 4 page 6
